title: 私を支えるたくさんの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking through town one day after Satono Diamond's first G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Arcade Employee
text_block_list.text: Our Satono Diamond G1 victory celebration is underway! Enter the raffle for a chance to win marvelous prizes! Every customer gets one free try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My curiosity piqued by the employee's words, I enter the arcade. The interior is covered in flashy decorations, including photos from Satono Diamond's race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Did you come to play some games too?
choice_data_list: Actually, I came to check out this event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask them why this arcade is holding a Satono Diamond event.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This place offers arcade cabinets developed by the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: In order to commemorate my G1 victory, events are being held at the group's partner facilities.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's Satono Group policy to give back to customers and share the happiness of special occasions.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they must have received approval from the academy too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since the matter is not directly related to racing, the academy likely handled everything on their side.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We're about to go to a diner. Would you like to come too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes! Please come with us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yay! Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah! Would you mind waiting a moment before we go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond speaks to an employee and hands him an autographed card. She then proceeds to sign one of the arcade cabinets.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia is going around to all the group facilities to give them autographs to display!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She came up with the idea herself, with the hope that visiting customers might enjoy seeing it!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She obviously can't visit all the facilities across the country, so she's decided to send out signed cards stamped with the cleats she wore during the G1 race instead!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry for the wait. Let's get going, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Three Dia Burgers, please!

text_block_list.name: Diner Staff
text_block_list.text: Coming right up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. The Dia Burger recipe is actually based on the hamburger steaks my mom would make for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …The day before a race, she'd always step in for the chefs in the kitchen and make a hamburger steak for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A plump hamburger steak topped with a diamond-shaped slice of cheese. And she'd stick a handmade flag in the middle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No matter how busy she was with work, my mom would always take the time to make one. It was her way of cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's why it's called a Dia Burger!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Right. I doubt they'll taste exactly like my mom's, but I'm looking forward to trying one. ♪

text_block_list.name: Diner Staff
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting. Here are your Dia Burgers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow, they're finally ready! Let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Mmm!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This tastes almost exactly like my mom's! I love how tender it is—it practically melts in your mouth!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. She must have had direct input on the recipe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Dia Burger definitely has a considerable home-cooked feel to it for something on a diner menu.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Considering all of these grand events they're holding, your parents must be over the moon about your first G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… They did call to congratulate me, but it was a pretty normal conversation. They seemed rather busy with work.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They did say they'd celebrate with me the next time I returned home, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …Can you two still fit more in your stomachs?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A cafe run by the group is having a cake event to commemorate my G1 win.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Let's go there for dessert! ♪ And later we can go to our indoor amusement park, where all the rides are currently free.
choice_data_list: Is this why your parents were busy?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They were probably running around preparing all these commemoration events.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me there are special events at all the group's facilities…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, and one-night reservations made at the Satono Resort Hotel today are only 500 yen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You might want to take advantage of that deal, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: They really are holding events everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The scale of this celebration is extraordinary. You can really tell how thrilled both Satono Diamond's parents and the rest of her family are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's G1 triumph—a first for the Satono family—was a great achievement and has brought joy to countless people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hope we continue to achieve many victories together.
